rules.name: Derive state or province from location
rules.statement: When a complete ZIP or postal code changes and a matching state or province can be determined from the available options, select it. The applicant may change the selection manually; that manual choice persists until the ZIP or postal code changes again. US ZIP+4 and Canadian postal formatting are supported. If no match is found, leave the current state unchanged and allow manual selection.

rules.name: Keep location lookup optional
rules.statement: Location lookup uses the currently available state/province options. A missing match must not clear a manual selection, block submission, or act as an eligibility failure. The selected state/province is validated against its effective options independently of ZIP/postal inference.
